entries.title: Jeremiah 30:1
segments: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:2
segments: So speaks the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:3
segments: For, lo, the days come, says the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of My people Israel and Judah, says the LORD. And I will cause them to return to the land that I gave their fathers, and they shall possess it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:4
segments: And these [are] the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:5
segments: For so says the LORD, We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:6
segments: Ask now, and see whether a man is giving birth? Why do I see every man with his hands on his loins, like a woman in labor, and all faces are turned into paleness?

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:7
segments: Alas! For that day [is] great, so that none [is] like it; it [is] even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:8
segments: For it shall be in that day, says the LORD of hosts, I will break his yoke from your neck and will burst your bonds. And strangers shall no longer enslave him,

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:9
segments: but they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:10
segments: And you, O My servant Jacob, do not fear, says the LORD. Do not be terrified, O Israel. For lo, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity. And Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make [him] afraid.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:11
segments: For I [am] with you, says the LORD, to save you. Though I make a full end of all nations where I have scattered you, yet I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will not leave you entirely unpunished.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:12
segments: For so says the LORD, Your break cannot be cured, and your wound [is] grievous.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:13
segments: [There is] none to plead your cause; for [your] ulcer there are [no] healing medicines for you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:14
segments: All your lovers have forgotten you; they do not seek you. For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity; [because] your sins are many.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:15
segments: Why do you cry over your crushing? Your pain [is] incurable, for the greatness of your iniquity; because your sins are many, I have done these things to you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:16
segments: So all those who devour you shall be devoured; and all your enemies, every one of them, shall go into captivity. And they who rob you shall be robbed, and all who strip you I will strip.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:17
segments: For I will give health back to you, and will heal you of your wounds, says the LORD; because they called you an outcast, [saying], This is Zion; no one is seeking for her.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:18
segments: So says the LORD: Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and will have mercy on his dwelling places. And the city shall be built on her own hill, and the palace shall remain in its own place.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:19
segments: And out of them shall come thanksgiving, and the voice of those who rejoice. And I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:20
segments: Also their sons shall be as they were before, and their congregation shall be established before Me, and I will punish all who ill-treat them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:21
segments: And their rulers shall be of themselves, and their governor shall come from among them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach Me. For who [is] this who pledged his heart to come near to Me? says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:22
segments: And you shall be My people, and I will be your God.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:23
segments: Behold, the tempest of the LORD goes forth with fury, a never-ending tempest; it shall fall with pain on the head of the wicked.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:24
segments: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return until He has done [it], and until He has fulfilled the intentions of His heart. In the latter days you shall understand it.
